answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 380 Country: Pakistan Title: Is Namaz-e-Janaza permissible in premises of Masjid? Question: Is Namaz-e-Janaza permissible in premises of Masjid? Answer ID: 380 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 466/J) It is prohibited to pray Janazah prayer in mosque premises, it is not right. The Janazah prayer should be performed outside mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
